$comment: Source of truth: for each job, the ONE component or pattern to use, and the ones that are wrong for it. Read by the docs site, AGENTS.md, llms.txt and the lint checker. Edit here only.

jobs.job: Run the main action of a page or panel
jobs.how: `variant="default"`, once per view
notThis: a link styled as a button

jobs.job: Run any other action
jobs.how: `variant="outline"`, or `"ghost"` in toolbars, rows and bars

jobs.job: Go to another page
jobs.how: `variant="link"` or a plain link

jobs.job: Show a keyboard shortcut
jobs.how: Button `shortcut` prop, or one `<Kbd>` per key

jobs.job: Show code, a command or log output to copy
jobs.how: `<Code>` inside sentences, `<CodeBlock>` for anything longer

jobs.job: Show the status of a record
jobs.how: always a word, tone by meaning

jobs.job: Label or categorise a record
Switch between sections of a page
Switch between 2 or 3 views of the same data
Offer several actions on one record
Turn a setting on or off, applied immediately
Pick options in a form that is submitted later
Explain an icon-only button
Confirm an action the person just took
jobs.how: with Undo when reversible

jobs.job: Something on the page needs attention
Something needs a person to act, later
Stop before an irreversible action
jobs.how: states the consequence, safe option first

jobs.job: Show or edit one record next to the list
jobs.how: `mode="push"` by default, `"overlay"` below 1100px

jobs.job: Show nothing yet, or no results
notThis: an empty table with no message

jobs.job: Show content while it loads
Something failed to load
jobs.how: say what failed, keep filters, offer Try again

jobs.job: Find anything or run a command
Scan and triage records
Edit, enrich or export many columns
Show spreadsheet-like data people scan many rows of, such as an inventory, a ledger or a bill of materials
jobs.how: `Table size="dense"` with `TableGroupRow`, `TableRowNumber`, frozen columns (`data-pinned`) and `TableFilterRow`

jobs.job: Group a table's rows into sections, such as Inputs, Wastes and emissions and Products
jobs.how: One `TableBody` per group with `TableGroupRow` (label, info tooltip, count, collapsible); in a sheet, `SheetGrid groupBy`

jobs.job: Offer a shortcut button inside a table row, such as Open or Share
jobs.how: `TableCellAction` with an aria-label naming the row, and the same action in the `TableRowNumber` menu
notThis: a hover-only action with no menu item

jobs.job: Let people select ranges, paste from Excel or Google Sheets, fill down and undo cell edits
jobs.how: `SheetGrid` (`size="dense"` for spreadsheet-like data) with `onCellsChange`; `ShortcutSheet` groups from `sheetGridShortcuts()`

jobs.job: Run the usual action with a few variants, such as Import data with Import all and Import selection
jobs.how: `SplitButton` with `menuLabel="More import options"` and `DropdownMenuItem` variants
notThis: a Button beside a hand-made menu trigger

jobs.job: Filter a list by a few fields
jobs.how: pills: field, operator, value; apply on tick
notThis: a filter row under each column

jobs.job: Search with many fields
Save a combination of filters, columns and sort
Act on several selected rows
notThis: a toolbar that replaces the filters

jobs.job: Show one number that matters
jobs.how: number, change with arrow and sign, what it compares to

jobs.job: Show change over time
Compare amounts across categories
Ask the assistant about what is on screen
jobs.how: `⌘J`; selection and filters become context chips

jobs.job: Have the AI change data
jobs.how: proposal with checkboxes, Apply, then Undo
notThis: batch Apply for decisions about people

jobs.job: Mark content written by AI
Let an agent act on someone's behalf
jobs.how: Off / Ask first / Allow; decisions about candidates are capped at Ask first
notThis: Allow on decisions with legal or similar effects on people

jobs.job: Group one settings section or form
jobs.how: `Card` with header, content, footer actions on the right; `CardFooter band` for one secondary line

jobs.job: Divide two ways of doing the same thing
jobs.how: `FieldSeparator` with “or”; plain `Separator` between groups

jobs.job: Guide a task done in steps, in order
jobs.how: `Stepper steps current onStepSelect`; 3 to 6 steps

jobs.job: Show how a total splits over time, such as applications by source per week
jobs.how: `ChartArea` with 2 to 5 `series` stacked from zero, legend toggles, `Table` view

jobs.job: Show a count against its plan or average in the same unit
jobs.how: `ChartMixed` with one `bar` series and up to three `line` series on one y-axis

jobs.job: Show how one total splits at a single moment into a few parts
jobs.how: `ChartDonut` with 2 to 5 `segments`, centre `total` and `unit`, labels as count and share

jobs.job: See whether two measures move together across listings and spot outliers
jobs.how: `ChartScatter` with up to 3 `groups` (colour plus marker shape), axis titles with units, popover linking to the record

jobs.job: Pick the right chart for a question on a dashboard
jobs.how: Tag the question (trend, anomaly, comparison, investigation), then use the chart-choice step; finish with title, units, `Table` view and four states

jobs.job: Find out why a chart spiked or dropped on a given day
jobs.how: Pin the `ChartPopover` on the point, read the breakdown, then "Filter chart" or "Filter page" to add pills to the `FilterBar`

jobs.job: Mark a target or limit on a chart
jobs.how: Add a `threshold` (dashed, neutral, with a text `label`) instead of an extra series

jobs.job: Build the team's weekly hiring overview that everyone reads the same way
jobs.how: 12-column grid: `stat-compare` row at full width, then `chart-card-line` and short `list-table` items at 6 columns, getting started and links at the bottom

jobs.job: Let each recruiter choose and arrange what they see on their home page
jobs.how: `Board` with `BoardItem`s, Add items in `page-header` opening `items-palette` in `side-panel`, layout saved per person, Reset to default layout in the more menu

jobs.job: Decide what to put inside a new dashboard tile
jobs.how: Pick one type (key metrics, chart, list, status and alerts, quick links, getting started, feature news); one header action, `dropdown-menu` for the rest, footer "View all N" link

jobs.job: Let someone add a chart back to their dashboard after removing it
jobs.how: Open Add items; the removed item is listed again; drag it or press its `Add to dashboard` button

jobs.job: Give people a way back after rearranging their dashboard badly
jobs.how: `Reset to default layout` in the page header more menu, applied at once with a `toast` offering Undo

jobs.job: Get a different version of the assistant's last answer
jobs.how: `AnswerActions` Regenerate on the latest answer; version switch `2 / 2`; Stop replaces Send while writing

jobs.job: Give the person a job description or CSV the assistant made
jobs.how: `ArtifactCard` under the answer with `Open`/`Download`; record-bound drafts use `Suggest for LST-…` into `SuggestedChanges`

jobs.job: Collect a closing date and salary band before preparing a new listing
jobs.how: Inline `Card` with up to five required, prefilled fields and `Continue`, which produces `SuggestedChanges`

jobs.job: See what an agent did last week and which run changed a listing
jobs.how: `GroupedList` by day with time, `StatusBadge` outcome and past-tense label linking to the `AgentRun` step; `FilterBar` by agent and outcome

jobs.job: Turn an agent on or off and limit which listings it touches
jobs.how: Agents page `ListTable` with `Switch` (Undo toast) and row detail in `SidePanel` showing `AgentPermissions` and scope

jobs.job: Let a person approve a tool call the agent needs mid-conversation
jobs.how: Approval card above `MessageComposer`: `Allow once` / `Allow in this conversation` / `Always allow`, focus on heading, resolved line afterwards

jobs.job: Explain why an action can't be used right now
jobs.how: `Button aria-disabled` with `Tooltip` reason "Available when the listing is Live."; hide it if the role can never use it

jobs.job: Let people reorder pipeline stages or columns
jobs.how: Grip handle plus keyboard pick-up (Enter, arrows, Enter) and `DropdownMenu` items Move up / Move down

jobs.job: Tell people a save, load or action failed
jobs.how: Field: `FormField error`; form: `Banner variant="error"` above actions; region: `ErrorState` with Try again

jobs.job: Explain a field or concept that needs more than a label
jobs.how: Info link beside the label opens `HelpPanel topic="visa-sponsorship"` in the right slot

jobs.job: Decide which right-hand panel to use
jobs.how: Record: `SidePanel`; questions about data: `AssistantPanel`; guidance: `HelpPanel`; one open at a time

jobs.job: Ask people whether a help topic or report was useful
jobs.how: `FeedbackPrompt question="Was this helpful?"` at the end of the content, follow-up revealed after the vote

jobs.job: Stop people losing a half-written listing
jobs.how: Autosave drafts with `Timestamp` "Draft saved"; `ConfirmationDialog` "Discard changes?" only when dirty; `beforeunload` while dirty

jobs.job: Show when something happened or is due
jobs.how: `Timestamp format="relative"` in tables, `format="absolute"` in details and deadlines, `by` for the source

jobs.job: Place actions for a page, a selection and a single row
jobs.how: `PageHeader actions` (one primary, last), `BulkActionBar` for selections, row icon buttons plus `DropdownMenu` More actions

jobs.job: Pick between radio, checkbox, switch and select
jobs.how: Up to 7 options: `RadioGroup` or `Checkbox` group; 8+: select; immediate on/off: `Switch`

jobs.job: Add a new job listing
jobs.how: `Create listing` in the `page-header` opens a single page with `card` sections, defaults filled in and `Additional settings` collapsed; never disable the submit `button`.

jobs.job: Publish a listing to external job boards
jobs.how: Use the `stepper` with 3 to 5 steps ending in a Review step whose `Edit` links return to each step.

jobs.job: Add a location that does not exist yet while creating a listing
jobs.how: Offer `Create "Leeds office"` in the select, or open an overlay `side-panel`; select the new item and return focus to the field.

jobs.job: Change the salary and location of a listing
jobs.how: Section `Edit` in the `card` header turns the section into a form with `Save` and `Cancel`; `toast` "Listing updated. Undo".

jobs.job: Change the stage of many candidates
jobs.how: Edit the cell in the `data-grid` or use the `bulk-action-bar`; Undo in the `toast`.

jobs.job: Delete a duplicate candidate record
jobs.how: Move to Deleted at once with `toast` "Candidate deleted. Undo" and ⌘Z; no dialog.

jobs.job: Erase a candidate's data on request
jobs.how: `confirmation-dialog` with role `alertdialog`, the name in bold, what is erased and what stays, buttons `Keep candidate` and `Delete permanently`.

jobs.job: Delete a whole workspace or a team with live listings
jobs.how: `confirmation-dialog` plus a warning `banner` listing what else goes and a `text-input` where the person types the name.

jobs.job: Decide where a new area of the product goes in the navigation
jobs.how: Add an item to the `app-shell` sidebar only if people go there directly; keep the `breadcrumb` and sidebar labels identical.

jobs.job: Tell people about a new Reports page
jobs.how: `New` text label after the sidebar item, opening a popover with two sentences and Learn more; remove after 30 days.

jobs.job: Mark an AI feature as beta
jobs.how: `FeatureLabel kind="Beta"` in the sidebar (`SidebarItem tag`) and after the page title (`PageHeader titleAddon`), popover saying results may change, plus Send feedback; still label output per `labelling-ai-output`.

jobs.job: Agree a multi-step or costly run before it starts
jobs.how: `PlanCard` with removable steps and risk marks; approval starts the `AgentRun`; a mid-run change adds `PlanChange`.

jobs.job: Review a change an agent proposes to procedures, prompts, tools or another agent
jobs.how: `ChangeRequest` with reason, `AiOrigin`, `DiffView` and `SimulationResults`; Approve, or Reject with a reason; list open ones in the Inbox.

jobs.job: Tell people the agent is unsure
jobs.how: `ConfidenceNote` with the cause in words and a safer option or a way to check; ask first when the scope of a change is unclear.

jobs.job: Explain why the agent chose something
jobs.how: `WhyChoice` next to the choice: factors, options that lost, anything it couldn't meet, then Change this or Keep it.

jobs.job: Let people sign in with Google, Microsoft, SSO or email
jobs.how: `SignInOptions` with `providers` and `ssoDomains`; errors under the email field.

jobs.job: Set up a new account in a few steps
jobs.how: Three to five `OnboardingStep`s; optional ones with Skip; then a `SetupChecklist` in the sidebar.

jobs.job: Upload a profile picture, logo or document
jobs.how: `FileDrop` with `accept`, `hint` and `maxBytes`; preview once chosen.

jobs.job: Connect Google, Slack, a CRM or another service
jobs.how: `ConnectorPicker` with what each connection can do; `ConnectDialog` for OAuth or an API key test.

jobs.job: Show credits, seats or storage against a limit
jobs.how: `UsageMeter` with used, limit, unit and reset date; upgrade link appears from 80%.

jobs.job: Show a third-party service's logo
jobs.how: `ProviderLogo provider="google"` beside its name; add new ones in scripts/provider-logos.mjs.

jobs.job: Show how one total splits at one moment, in a line of space
jobs.how: `ShareBar` with up to 6 `parts`; the rest fold into grey Other; `shareTable` for the table view

jobs.job: Rank items by one measure beside a stacked chart, as its legend
jobs.how: `RankedList` with `colorIndex` matching the chart's series, change with arrow and sign

jobs.job: List prices, indices or rates with today's change
jobs.how: `ChangeList` with name, code, value and unit, change, optional `spark`, and `seeAll`

jobs.job: Show a price moving within a narrow range today
jobs.how: `PriceChart` over the whole session with `reference` (previous close) and `live`; the axis says when it does not start at zero
notThis: a line chart cropped without saying so

jobs.job: Explain how an opening amount became a closing amount
jobs.how: `Waterfall` with `total` steps in grey and changes in c1 and c2 with + and − labels

jobs.job: Show actual against target for a few measures
jobs.how: `BulletChart` rows with `value`, `target` and neutral `bands`

jobs.job: Show which of many items make up most of a total
jobs.how: `Treemap` with up to 12 `items`, optional `group` for colour and legend

jobs.job: Show how a quantity flows across two or three stages
jobs.how: `SankeyChart` with `nodes` and `links`; `sankeyTable` for the table view

jobs.job: Show how one set of values is spread
jobs.how: `Histogram` with `binValues(values, { binWidth })` and an optional median `marker`

jobs.job: Compare how spread out several groups are
jobs.how: `BoxPlot` with raw `values` per group on one shared axis

jobs.job: Show daily open, high, low and close for a traded price
jobs.how: `CandlestickChart` with up hollow and down filled; volume as its own panel; `colors="market"` and `showLast` on trading screens
notThis: colour as the only sign of direction
volume on a second y axis

jobs.job: Show the prices people are offering to buy and sell at, and let them pick one
jobs.how: `OrderBook` with `asks`, `bids`, `steps` and `onSelectPrice` filling the order form's limit price
notThis: colour as the only sign of side

jobs.job: Build a table whose columns are looked up, calculated or written per row
jobs.how: `SheetGrid` with typed `columns` and computed cells in `rows[].computed`; `RunStatusBar` under it

jobs.job: Show, hide or reorder the columns of a sheet or list table
jobs.how: `ColumnsMenu` in the table toolbar; applies at once, with keyboard and Move buttons for reordering; on list tables add `onWrapChange` and `onPageSizeChange`

jobs.job: Show what a sheet is running, how far it is and what it costs
jobs.how: `RunStatusBar` with done, total, creditsUsed, costPerRow and onStop; Auto-run states its cost per row

jobs.job: Import rows from a CSV file
jobs.how: `CsvImport` with the table's `targets`: map, read the problem summary, then Import with the row count

jobs.job: Match fields from a file, form or service to a table's fields
jobs.how: `FieldMapping` with `targets`, `sources` and `autoMapFields`; required marked, type mismatches warned

jobs.job: Add a looked-up, AI, formula or export column to a sheet
jobs.how: `ActionCatalogue` in a `SidePanel` titled Add column; cost per row, then the total before adding, test on 10 rows by default

jobs.job: Set how a table handles duplicates, empty rows and template sharing
jobs.how: `TableSettings` in the side panel slot, saved with Save; asks before discarding only when changed

jobs.job: Show where something happens when location itself matters, such as conversion rate by country or ARR by city
jobs.how: `MapChart` with your TopoJSON and `values` as a rate (five steps, No data hatched), or `markers` for raw amounts; `mapTable` for the Table view
notThis: Bar chart or Ranked list to compare amounts

jobs.job: Show someone where the controls for a task are, after they ask
jobs.how: `GuideCue` with 1 to 3 `steps` (target ref or data attribute, title, body), opened from a `SetupChecklist` Start, Help menu, `HelpPanel` link or a `FeatureLabel` Show me via `useGuide().start`

jobs.job: See releases, maintenance windows or campaign phases across services or teams on one time scale
jobs.how: `Timeline` with `tracks`, `start`, `end` and `now` inside `ChartFrame` with `timelineTable`; `onSelect` opens the record in `SidePanel`

jobs.job: Show how much of a few fixed limits is used, such as seats, credits and storage, in a small card
jobs.how: `RadialBars` with 1 to 4 `items` ({ label, value, limit, unit }), used of limit written beside the rings, `radialBarsTable` for the table view
notThis: Bullet chart for actual against target
Donut chart for parts of one total

jobs.job: Show how a measure rises and falls through a repeating cycle, such as support tickets by hour of day
jobs.how: `RadialLines` with `periods` for one full cycle and 1 to 3 `series` (null for gaps), `periodLabel`, `radialLinesTable` for the table view
notThis: Line chart card for time that does not repeat
Heatmap for a cycle against a second dimension
an area fill that paints gaps as zero

jobs.job: Book and rearrange interviews, shifts or rooms across a few people on a calendar
jobs.how: `Scheduler` with `resources`, `view`/`onViewChange` and `date`/`onDateChange`; `onSelectEvent` opens `SidePanel`, `onCreate` opens a dialog of up to three fields, `onMove` applies with an Undo `toast`

jobs.job: Set a date on a record, such as a closing date or start date
jobs.how: `DatePicker` with `label`, ISO `value` and `onValueChange`; typing dd/mm/yyyy is the main path, Alt+↓ or the calendar button the second; `min`, `isDateUnavailable` and `unavailableReason` say which dates can't be chosen

jobs.job: Filter a list or chart to a period, such as the last 30 days or last quarter
jobs.how: In a filter bar, `DateFilterPill` beside `FilterPill` ("Applied is in Last 30 days"); in a form or chart header, `DateRangePicker` with `presets`. Store the value with `dateFilterToValues` in the URL and saved views, and get the dates with `resolveDateRange`

jobs.job: Pick one or several values from a list of eight or more, such as a location or skills
jobs.how: `Combobox` with `options` (add `multiple` for several); `onCreate` offers Create "Leeds office"; server search with `filter={null}`, `onSearch`, `loading` and `loadError`

jobs.job: Enter several free values that don't come from a list, such as email addresses to invite
jobs.how: `TagInput` with `validateValue` and `noun`; pasted lists are split, duplicates are reported and invalid values stay marked with their reason

jobs.job: Keep several regions of a tool page in view and let people resize and rearrange them, such as a trading screen
jobs.how: `PaneLayout` with `value`, `onValueChange`, `panes` and `onReset` inside `AppShell frame="flush"`; `usePaneSize` sizes charts and lists to their pane
notThis: a page that scrolls past regions people need together
a hand-built grid of fixed cards
